---
name: Rule proposal
about: Add, change or downgrade a rubric check or non-negotiable
title: "[rule] "
labels: rule
---

**The rule today** — quote it, with the check ID if it has one.

**The case where it produces a wrong result** — this is the part that matters. A rule
changes because it was wrong about something real, not because a different rule sounds
better.

**Proposed rule.**

**Severity** — blocker / warning / info, and why.

**What it would have caught** — ideally a defect you actually shipped.
